thesis: Express ivory as disciplined luminous architecture: dark progressive foundations carve space for polished warm-white statements and measured geometric returns.

artist_branding.summary: Daniel Portman visuals align with polished progressive-house control: driving but elegant phrasing, symmetric room architecture, and careful escalation over long form rather than chaotic effect spam.
visual_cues: Clean lane-based geometry with recurring center/downstage anchors
Dark foundational states supporting selective bright ivory revelations
Phrase-disciplined pacing where contrast is structural, not random
do_not_copy: Do not duplicate exact cover design assets, promo typography, or one-to-one cueing from official campaign videos.

motifs: Geometry motif: column-like beam stacks and mirrored routes that lock to center phrases
Color motif: steel-indigo body with ivory-white crests and restrained amber warmth
Movement motif: 4-beat quantized repositioning with inclusion bursts during peak phrases

visual_direction.color_story: Begin in deep indigo and teal-steel tones, then graduate into ivory-white peaks with occasional amber support to preserve warmth and depth.
visual_direction.motion_story: Maintain bar-quantized movement discipline while increasing route complexity and speed in build/drop transitions.
visual_direction.staging_story: PAR layers provide structural bedrock while mover lanes narrate the stone-to-light journey through repeated geometric callbacks.

must_include: Bar-quantized mover routing with repeatable geometric signatures
Distinct ivory-white payoff zones contrasted against darker phrase beds
At least one inclusion relationship phrase where PAR pulse and mover phrase interlock
avoid: Extended rainbow effects that conflict with ivory identity
Overdense strobe usage that obscures melodic phrasing
Frequent motif resets that break long-form progressive coherence
